name: Copper/Gold Ratio as S&P 500 Leading Indicator
description: Analyzes the copper/gold ratio (HG/GC) as a macro regime indicator for S&P 500 forward returns. Rising ratio (above 63-day MA) signals economic optimism; falling ratio signals risk aversion. Compares 3-month forward SPY returns in each regime. Outputs: ratio time series with regime shading, regime-conditional return bars, regime flip event markers, and summary statistics table.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio → S&P 500 Forward Returns
# Rising ratio (above 63d MA) = economic optimism → better stock returns?
# Falling ratio (below 63d MA) = risk aversion → worse stock returns?

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Copper (HG) and Gold (GC) via reference futures + continuation
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# ffill reference data for calendar alignment (shared → asset-scoped reindex)
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio & Regime ---
ratio = hg_close / gc_close
ratio_ma = ma(period=63, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# Regime: rising = ratio above 63d MA, falling = below
is_rising = ratio > ratio_ma
is_falling = ratio <= ratio_ma

# Regime flips for event markers
flip_to_rising = crossover(ratio, ratio_ma)
flip_to_falling = crossunder(ratio, ratio_ma)
any_flip = flip_to_rising or flip_to_falling

# --- Forward Returns ---
# 3-month forward SPY return (63 trading days ≈ 3 calendar months)
fwd_3m = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Regime-conditional forward returns
rising_fwd = where(is_rising, fwd_3m)
falling_fwd = where(is_falling, fwd_3m)

# --- Regime shading series for line chart ---
# Use is_band on xy_lines: 1.0 when in regime, 0.0 otherwise
rising_band = 1.0 if is_rising else 0.0
falling_band = 1.0 if is_falling else 0.0

# Ratio value at flip for event markers
ratio_at_flip = where(any_flip, ratio)
ma_at_flip = where(any_flip, ratio_ma)
regime_label = where(any_flip, 1.0 if flip_to_rising else 0.0)

# --- Hit rate computation (ternary for correct aggregation) ---
rising_hit = where(is_rising, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_3m) and fwd_3m > 0) else 0.0)
falling_hit = where(is_falling, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_3m) and fwd_3m > 0) else 0.0)

# --- Output 1: Ratio Time Series with Regime Shading ---
ts = index()()

xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio: Rising vs Falling Regimes',
    category='Copper-Gold Macro Signal',
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='HG/GC Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='63d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rising Regime', color=Color.Emerald, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Falling Regime', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    y_axis_dp=4
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio, ratio_ma, rising_band, falling_band))

# --- Output 2: Punchline — Median 3M Forward Return by Regime ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does the Regime Predict 3-Month SPY Returns?',
    category='Copper-Gold Macro Signal',
    order=2,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rising Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Falling Ratio', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(values=(rising_fwd, falling_fwd))

# --- Output 3: Event Markers — Regime Flips ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='63d MA', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ratio_at_flip, ma_at_flip, regime_label, any_flip)

# --- Output 4: Summary Stats Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='3-Month Forward SPY Return by Regime',
        row_size=5, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Daily Obs (N)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['Rising Ratio', 'Falling Ratio'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Copper-Gold Macro Signal',
    order=3
)(rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_hit, falling_hit, rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_fwd, falling_fwd)
